$comment: Inventory of the Webflare micropage design system at one commit. Token names and values only. A later update is a new, deliberate change.

actions.add: The library does not have the token. Add it with the micropage value.
actions.replace: Color the library already has. The micropage value replaces it.
actions.keep: Same path and same value in both (hex compared without letter case). Nothing changes.
actions.keep-library: Non-color token in both with a different spelling or value. The library value is kept.
actions.publish-as: Published under the nested library role name in `publishedAs`, with the micropage value.

dark.note: Every mode-dependent value repeats the dark value under both conditions.

modes.note: Light is the base. Dark applies inside a `.dark` class and when the OS prefers dark. No class switches back to light when the OS prefers dark.

methods: hex colors with alpha (accent-subtle and accent-border in dark mode)
rgb() with alpha (card and float shadows)

fonts.loading: Downloaded at build time and served from the site itself. No runtime requests to Google. No font files in the source.
fonts.note: The library keeps Figtree, ships no font files, and keeps fonts.body as an alias of fonts.sans.

config.note: Same values in the library, which has more breakpoints.
Component recipes are out of scope. Library components keep their structure.
